remuneration_policy.evidence: Maximum variable remuneration which may be granted is the sum of the annual bonus and restricted shares award (excluding the value of any buyouts) which is 275% of salary. The annual bonus plan provides a significant incentive to the Executive Directors. The Committee will determine the maximum annual participation in the annual bonus plan for each year, which will not exceed 150% of salary.
